local.setIn: Set in Canada. All amounts are in Canadian dollars.

high.label: Lavish wedding
high.diary: We had a lavish wedding. I'll never forget our guests' smiles.

mid.label: Standard wedding
mid.diary: We had a simple but heartfelt wedding.

low.label: City hall + small party
low.diary: We married at city hall and threw a small party with friends.

wedding.skip: We skipped the ceremony and shared a quiet toast, just the two of us.

high.label: Europe
high.diary: Honeymoon in Europe. We walked cobblestone streets hand in hand.

mid.label: Mexico all-inclusive
mid.diary: Honeymoon at an all-inclusive in Cancún. We barely left the beach.

low.label: Road trip
low.diary: Our honeymoon was a road trip through the Rockies. The lakes were unreal.

honeymoon.skip: We skipped the honeymoon. "Someday," we promised.

high.diary: We decided we'd both work full-time.

mid.diary: My partner switched to shorter hours / part-time.

low.diary: My partner left work to focus on home.

high.label: Luxury car
high.diary: We bought a luxury car. Driving it makes us sit up straight.

mid.label: New car
mid.diary: We bought a new car. Weekend drives became our joy.

low.label: Used car
low.diary: We bought a used car. A bit old, but it runs fine.

car.skip: We didn't buy a car. Transit and the odd car share will do.
car.never: We decided to live without a car.

high.label: Nanny / private daycare
high.diary: We hired a nanny, then moved to a private daycare.

mid.label: Licensed daycare
mid.diary: After months on the waitlist, we got a spot at a licensed daycare.

low.label: Grandparents
low.diary: The grandparents will look after them. They're thrilled.

high.label: Private
high.diary: Started at a private elementary school. The uniform looks great.

mid.label: Public + activities
mid.diary: Started public elementary school, plus hockey and swimming lessons.

low.label: Public
low.diary: Started public elementary school. The backpack looks huge.

high.label: Private
high.diary: Started at a private middle school.

mid.label: Public + tutoring
mid.diary: Started public middle school, with a tutor too.

low.label: Public
low.diary: Started public middle school. Totally into hockey.

high.label: Private
high.diary: Started at a private high school.

mid.label: Public + tutoring
mid.diary: Started public high school, with a tutor for maths too.

high.label: University away from home
high.diary: Went to university in another province and moved into residence. ({years} yrs)

mid.label: University from home
mid.diary: Went to university in town, living at home. ({years} yrs)

low.label: College, then university
low.diary: Did a college diploma first, then transferred to university. ({years} yrs)

university.skip: Started an apprenticeship after high school. A working adult now.

high.label: Detached house
high.diary: We bought a detached house. We talked over the floor plan again and again.

mid.label: Townhouse
mid.diary: We bought a townhouse. Shovelling our own driveway feels great.

low.label: Older house + renovation
low.diary: We bought an older house and renovated it. Old, but full of charm.

house.skip: We didn't buy; we rented a bigger place.
house.never: We decided to rent for life. Travelling light is best.
house.majorRepair: The old house's roof and furnace gave out. Major renovation cost {cost:money}.

high.label: Full renovation
high.diary: We renovated the whole house. That'll hold for a while.

low.label: Quick fix
low.diary: We patched it up for now.

high.label: Trip abroad
high.diary: We took a family trip abroad.

mid.label: Cottage week
mid.diary: We rented a cottage on a lake for a week.

low.label: Day trip nearby
low.diary: We went on a day trip nearby. Still fun.

familyTrip.skip: We spent this year's anniversary relaxing at home.

S.comment: No more money worries. Let's go wherever we always wanted, whenever we like.

A.comment: Hobbies and travel to enjoy. We can laugh and say, "We did well."

B.comment: No luxuries, but no troubles either. Calm days go on.

C.comment: CPP and OAS alone feel thin. We'll get by together, saving where we can.

D.comment: We'll keep working a while. While we're able, that's not so bad.

bankrupt.comment: Debts piled up and our finances collapsed. Look back at where we overreached, and try again.
